name: ai-python311-compiler-runtime
used_as: read-only /compiler mount for the isolated build worker (agentloop/candidate_adapter.py COMPILER_RUNTIME); replaces the host directory ai-python311-10b0f650-002
notes: 907 files (CPython 3.11.16 + shared libraries) copied from the image and checked against the manifest; the manifest itself is copied verbatim, so candidate_adapter's COMPILER_MANIFEST_SHA256 still matches. Its image_id field records the paper image the file list came from (sha256:10b0f650...); the launcher compares it only with candidate_adapter.COMPILER_IMAGE_ID (same value), never with a Docker image id, so the content checks (manifest sha + per-file sha) are what bind the runtime.
